correctness.rationale: Proof reconstructs OR iterations as length-exact weight-two Cayley walks; builds length r and r+1 representations for every nonzero even-weight vector and length two/three return walks at zero, covering all t >= 2. At T=floor(n/2) the full parity component is reached; at T-1 only the antipodal shell can be missing. Singleton vs common-neighborhood subset counts, including double-counted pairs, give A_n and independent-component inclusion-exclusion gives E_n. No finite checks are substituted for this unrestricted construction. The actual package verifier reproduced 36 walk-shell tests, 246494 state tests and A_n for n=6..9.

value.rationale: An explicit all-dimensions count for a natural first-entry maximal-depth stratum in a highly symmetric Boolean network quantifies rare extremal initial states beyond any diameter/height scalar. A sharply different structure in even (singleton supports) and odd (arbitrary nonempty subsets of Hamming neighborhoods) dimensions explains the exact formula. It is a motivated structural classification rather than a small table or an arbitrary parameter slice.
